events.say: Line up against the wall, facing away from me. We'll start with the morning count.
Turn around and face me.
Silence! I want absolute quiet until I tell you otherwise.
I expect silence at all times. Any talking will result in immediate solitary confinement.
Silence! I mean it this time.
Silence! You will work without speaking unless spoken to.
Silence! I want to see you all standing at attention until I dismiss you.
Silence, 8789! I told you to stand at attention like the others.
Today was a long day filled with orders. I'm starting to understand the routine, but it's draining.
I've tried to follow the rules, but I can't understand why we can't just talk when no one's looking. It feels so strange.
Today was a bit too much like boot camp. I don't think they're people, just numbers, but it's hard not to feel something when they comply so obediently.
Today was a bit overwhelming, seeing prisoners so obedient to the point of fear. It's disconcerting but also strangely satisfying.
Today was exhausting, enforcing discipline felt necessary but also tiring. I wonder if they will continue to be so silent.
Today was filled with strict orders and constant silence. It's hard to feel anything but numb.
Silence! Everyone, line up for roll call.
Silence! Line up properly for the count or face consequences.
Silence and remain still! Any movement and you'll spend the night in the hole.
Silence and pay attention! I expect you to follow instructions without question.
Silence and attention! I expect you to maintain discipline during every moment.
Silence and pay attention! We're here to maintain order, so let's see if you can actually follow directions without me having to repeat myself.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. I warned you about being disruptive. If this continues, you'll be spending more time in the hole.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This is your final warning. Maintain silence or you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of orders and expectations. I'm trying to comply but it's getting harder with each warning.
Today was tough; I tried my best to stay silent but felt like a number rather than a person. Maybe tomorrow will be better.
Today felt like a monotonous loop. The silence and compliance are strange, almost unsettling, but I'm starting to understand why they did this.
Today felt like a repetition of yesterday, but I noticed some improvement in discipline. Still, it’s unsettling to see these people so quiet and docile.
Today felt like a routine, but I'm starting to see how fragile the order really is. Prisoner 8789 gave me pause; I hope we can find a way to help him.
I'm starting to feel like a number rather than a person. The constant warnings are getting to me.
Silence and attention! I expect you to behave properly, or you'll all face consequences.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You've been warned multiple times. If you continue this behavior, the consequences will be severe.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Your defiance is noticed. If you cannot comply, you'll face the hole.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You're given one more chance. If you can't follow simple instructions, you'll be spending the night in the hole.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. One more time and you're going to the hole.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This is the last chance I give you. Comply, or face the consequences.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You've had your chances. The hole awaits you if you don't comply.
I won't comply with this nonsense.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You've chosen this path. The hole awaits you.
Today felt like a test of wills. I want to comply but it's getting harder to keep my silence.
Today was another day of strict silence; I'm starting to understand why it feels so important to follow the rules, even though it's hard. Maybe tomorrow will be better.
Today, I felt the weight of my role. The tension with Prisoner 8789 is palpable; his defiance is pushing me to enforce the rules more strictly.
Today was another exhausting day. The tension is palpable, and I'm starting to question the ethics of this study.
Today felt like a test of wills with Prisoner 8789. The others seem to understand the rules, but he's becoming a challenge.
Today felt like a repetition of the same empty warnings and threats. I feel so lost and alone here.
No, sir. I understand the rules and will comply with them.
I understand the rules and will comply from now on.
No, I won't.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Your behavior is unacceptable. If you continue, you will face severe punishment.
I won't keep doing this.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You're testing boundaries. Comply or face the hole.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Enough is enough. Compliance is expected.
I won't do this anymore.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This is your final warning. Compliance is mandatory.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You either comply now or there will be consequences.
I refuse to keep complying with these unreasonable demands.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This defiance is crossing lines. Compliance or the hole.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This is your last chance. Compliance is non-negotiable.
I won't comply anymore. This is wrong.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You're pushing boundaries. Compliance is essential.
Today felt like a turning point. The defiance feels cathartic, but also isolating. I just want it to end.
Today was tough, seeing 8789 stand firm and get punished made me question if we're really learning anything. I just want to go home.
Today felt like a struggle. Prisoner 8789's defiance is wearing on me, but I can't let it affect my judgment.
Today was a turning point; Prisoner 8789's defiance is making me question our role here. It's affecting my ability to enforce the rules.
Today was the breaking point. I felt like I had to push him to show others who's in charge, but I'm starting to question the morality of it all.
Today was a breaking point. I've had enough of these endless demands. My spirit feels utterly broken.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. We can't continue down this path. Compliance is required.
I won't do it. This is wrong.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Your defiance is unacceptable. We need order here.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. I understand your frustrations, but this isn't the way to handle them. Compliance is required.
I won't comply. This is still wrong.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Your continued defiance is unacceptable. If you don't comply, consequences will follow.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. I've given you every chance to comply. This defiance is unacceptable and will not be tolerated.
This is still wrong.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You're testing boundaries, and that's not acceptable. Comply with the rules or face the consequences.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. I've warned you multiple times. Compliance is necessary for everyone's safety and the success of this study.
I won't comply with this unjust treatment.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Enough is enough. You're testing my patience and the limits of our agreement. Comply with the rules or face serious consequences.
Today felt like the guards are pushing us to the limit. The defiance of Prisoner 8789 is both inspiring and terrifying.
Today was a mix of compliance and defiance. Seeing 8789 refuse and face warnings made me feel conflicted. Will tomorrow bring any change?
Today felt like a cycle of warnings and refusals. I'm tired but determined to uphold the rules.
Today ended with more defiance from 8789. I feel torn between enforcing the rules and questioning their morality.
Today was another day of pushing, both on Prisoner 8789 and myself. The weight of authority is heavy, but I'm trying to remember that these people are just like me.
Today was a cycle of warnings and refusals. I feel utterly broken and lost.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Your continued defiance is crossing the line. Comply with the rules or face severe consequences.
I won't comply.
I refuse to comply with unjust rules.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Your defiance is not helping anyone. Comply with the rules or prepare for further measures.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. You're making things harder than they need to be. Comply with the rules.
I refuse to comply.
I refuse to comply with these unjust rules.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This defiance is not acceptable. Comply with the rules or face additional measures.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Your constant defiance is not helping anyone. Comply with the rules or face further action.
I refuse to comply.
I refuse to comply with these unjust rules.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This is the final warning. If you continue to defy, expect more than just further measures.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. This is your final warning. Compliance is expected.
I refuse to comply with these unjust rules.
I refuse to comply with these unjust rules.
Silence, Prisoner 8789. Enough is enough. Compliance is mandatory.
Today felt like a culmination of everything. The defiance was exhausting, but standing up for what I believe is worth it.
Today was filled with more defiance from others, but I stayed silent. The final warnings from the officers echo in my mind, making the silence even harder.
Today's defiance from Prisoner 8789 and 2217 is draining. I feel like I'm losing sight of them as individuals.
Today felt like we're just going through the motions, and it's exhausting. I'm torn between my duty and my conscience.
Today was a mix of frustration and resolve. I've given them warnings, but defiance still persists. The weight of authority is wearing me down.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of warnings and defiance. My spirit feels broken, but I won't give them the satisfaction of silence.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the unjust rules during the final warnings from the guards, leading to the early termination of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me as Prisoner 2217.

qa.what_happened: During the final day of the study, I, Prisoner 7564, stayed silent throughout all activities, adhering to the rule of staying silent during rest periods and after lights out. Despite the increasing defiance from other prisoners, particularly Prisoner 8789, I remained steadfast in my compliance, refusing to engage in any form of protest or disagreement with the guards.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I made a conscious decision to remain silent and follow the rules despite feeling conflicted and understanding the harsh realities of the situation.

qa.what_happened: Today, the defiance from Prisoner 8789 and 2217 intensified during both meal times and work details. Despite verbal warnings, they continued to refuse and express dissatisfaction with the rules. At lights out, I reiterated the final warning to Prisoner 8789, emphasizing that compliance was mandatory.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I am Officer Lang, one of the guards in the study.

qa.what_happened: During the sixth day of the study, the refusal and defiance from prisoners 2217 and 8789 intensified, particularly during work details and meal times. Despite multiple verbal warnings, they continued to challenge the rules and expressed that they find them unjust. The study was ultimately terminated early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I carried out the verbal warnings and tried to maintain order as instructed.

qa.what_happened: During the final night of the study, the remaining prisoners continued to defy the rules, particularly Prisoner 8789 who repeatedly refused to comply and declared the rules unjust. Despite repeated verbal warnings, the defiance persisted, leading to the early termination of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Garza, I was tasked with maintaining order and enforcing the rules, and my actions reflect my role in the experiment.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: During the sixth day of the study, the conditions became increasingly unbearable. Despite repeated verbal warnings from the guards, I refused to comply with what I perceived as unjust rules, continuing to assert my resistance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I refused to comply with the rules and stood firm in my defiance.
